title: Runway Briefing — Boeing's $36 Billion Headache, American's Widebody Gap, and O'Leary's €150 Million Pay Day
summary: Boeing lands the biggest order of the year and still can't catch a break on the 737 MAX. American Airlines is quietly boxed into a corner on its next widebody jet, Ryanair shareholders stage a revolt that doesn't actually change anything, and Heathrow's third runway slips yet again — this time to 2039. Plus, Boston airlines are flying with extra gas in the tank because of a nor'easter.
